freyacad · wrong-sized workshop

This bench doesn’t fold down to touch size.

freyacad is a full parametric CAD bench — a real solid-modelling kernel, sketches, fillets, booleans — and it drives with a mouse, a keyboard and a hover cursor. On a phone or a tablet it would be all thumbs. Literally.

Open it on a PC or a Mac and the whole workshop will be set up and waiting for you.
